strings.tools.remplir.guide.steps[1].text: Nea ɛte no kyerɛ wo mmuae wɔ krataafa no so.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.steps[2].title: Kɔ so Hyɛ krataa ma
strings.tools.remplir.guide.steps[2].text: Woto PDF a ahyɛ ma no.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[0].q: Adɛn nti na pdff nhu mmeae biara?
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[0].a: PDF no nyɛ krataa a wotumi hyɛ ma (ɛtaa yɛ scan). Ɛsɛ sɛ wumpi anaa wubisa adwumakuo no krataa foforo.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[1].q: Ebɛn ase na "Bɔ mmuae no mu" yɛ?
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[1].a: Mmuae no bɛyɛ krataafa no fã na wuntumi nsakra bio.
strings.tools.comparer.name: Toto ho
strings.tools.comparer.tagline: Hwɛ ne a asakra wɔ PDF nkrataa abien ntam.
strings.tools.comparer.seoTitle: Toto PDF abien ho intanɛt so: hwɛ nsakrae
strings.tools.comparer.seoDescription: Toto apam anaa PDF krataa abien ho: asɛm a wɔka ho wɔ ahabammono mu, asɛm a woyii wɔ kɔkɔɔ mu, ne nkrataa nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wotumi to. Ɛyɛ kwa, wunsiw hwee kɔ soro.
strings.tools.comparer.intro: Gu krataa dada no, na afei foforo no: nsakrae no ba ntɛm ara, asɛm biara mu. Kɔ so Toto ho to fa nkyerɛkyerɛmu no. Biribiara kɔ so w'intanɛt brazer mu.
strings.tools.comparer.options.ignoreCase.label: Mfa nkrɛw kɛse ne ketewa ho kwan
strings.tools.comparer.guide.keywords: compare two pdfs, pdf diff, compare two versions of a document, compare contracts, find changes in pdf
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[0]: Hwɛ ne a asakra apam anaa krataa mu ansa na wotwɛ nsaano nkrataa gu so.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[1]: Hwɛ nkrataa nsesae a wɔyɛ ma rapotu anaa sukuu krataa.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[2]: Toto mbra anaa aban asɛm abien ho.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[0].title: Gu krataa dada no
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[0].text: Na foforo no, saa kwan no so.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].title: Kenkan nsakrae no
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].text: Ahabammono kyerɛ ne a wɔde kaa ho, kɔkɔɔ kyerɛ ne a woyii.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[2].title: Kɔ so Toto ho
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[2].text: Woto nkyerɛkyerɛmu sɛ wosie anaa wumpi.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[0].q: Wosiw me nkrataa no kɔ soro?
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[0].a: Daabi: toto no kɔ so koraa w'intanɛt brazer mu.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[1].q: Wotumi toto nkrataa a wɔscan ho?
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[1].a: Aane, bere a wode fa Kenkan scan afidie no mu na ɛyi asɛm no fi mu no.
strings.tools.images.name: Yi mfonini
strings.tools.images.tagline: Yi mfonini ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu fi PDF mu.
strings.tools.images.seoTitle: Yi mfonini fi PDF mu intanɛt so sɛ ɛyɛ kwa
strings.tools.images.seoDescription: Yi mfonini, nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne agyiraehyɛde biara fi PDF mu sɛ PNG anaa JPG, a nkrataa mmienu nni mu. Ɛyɛ kwa, wunsiw wo din, fayil yiyi fi hɔ ntɛm ara.
strings.tools.images.intro: Gu PDF: pdff hu mfonini biara a ɛwɔ mu na ɛma wo baako baako, sɛ PNG anaa JPG, ZIP fayil mu. Mfonini nketewa ne nkrataa mmienu gyae hɔ.
strings.tools.images.options.format.label: Mfonini format
strings.tools.images.options.format.hints.png: Ne kɛse pa ara, ma kyerɛ mu da hɔ.
strings.tools.images.options.format.hints.jpg: Fayil nketewa, pa ara ma mfonini.
strings.tools.images.options.small.label: San fa mfonini nketewa (agyiraehyɛde, nsoromma)
strings.tools.images.guide.keywords: extract images from pdf, save images from pdf, get photos out of a pdf, pdf image extractor
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[0]: Yi mfonini fi PDF katalog, rapotu anaa buukuu mu.
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[1]: San fa agyiraehyɛde anaa chart di dwuma krataa ho dwumadie bi mu.
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[2]: Sie krataa mfonini ansa na woyi.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[0].title: Gu wo PDF no
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].title: Paw PNG anaa JPG
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].text: PNG ma ne kɛse pa ara, JPG ma fayil nketewa.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].title: Kɔ so Yi mfonini
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].text: Wunya mfonini nyinaa ZIP fayil mu.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].q: Sɛnea ɛyɛ soro ne sɛ wubɛsakra PDF ayɛ JPG?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].a: Sakra yɛ krataafa biara mfonini. Yi mfonini yi mfonini ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛwɔ krataafa no mu nko ara, wɔn kɛse ankasa mu.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].q: Adɛn nti na mfonini bi yera?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].a: Mfonini nketewa (agyiraehyɛde, nsoromma) yiyi kwan: paw "San fa mfonini nketewa". Asɛm ne mfonini nketewa nyɛ mfonini, enti wonsi.
strings.tools.redimensionner.name: Sakra ne kɛse / twɛ
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoTitle: Sakra ne kɛse na twɛ mfonini intanɛt so sɛ ɛyɛ kwa
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoDescription: Tew mfonini kɛse (fa % anaa pixels mu) anaa twɛ ayɛ sikasɛm, 16:9 anaa 4:3, na afei sie sɛ JPG, PNG anaa WebP. Ɛyɛ kwa, wunsiw wo din.
strings.tools.redimensionner.intro: Gu wo mfonini, paw sɛ wotew kɛse anaa wotwɛ, hwɛ ne a ɛte, na afei kɔ so Sakra ne kɛse / twɛ. Ɛboa ma pofayil mfonini, fayil a ɛyɛ duru dodo anaa krataa a ehia kɛse pɔtee.
